about: Modwerk's Analog Rytm MKII base for OS 1.74, built by npm run machine:base -- analog-rytm-mkii from core-ar2 0.7's source (sdk/imports/core-ar2-source-fb58292.json) and, in the send-bus variant, Modwerk's base/ sources. Two variants, each identified by its SHA-256 in sdk/machines/analog-rytm-mkii/base-binding.json: plain (e558ad22, the source alone) and send-bus (0cdf0343, with the FX track's lock words, the send bus and the sequencer's time). The site builds a Rytm set on send-bus when it holds a send effect (sdk/machines/analog-rytm-mkii/fx-ids.json) and on plain otherwise. Stock-free: each site names its stock bytes by length and SHA-256, and the build fills them from the owner's OS.
